name: Derby Summer Programs
description_short: Half-day summer programs (9:00 AM–12:00 PM) at Derby Academy in Hingham for ages 4–15, in four tracks: Camp Derby, Arts, STEM and Sports. Families can pay extra for an Extended Day through 4:00 PM that includes lunch, the noontime show, a daily choice period and two more classes.
